dedupe_keys.name: tripi transport infrastructure extraction and material stock processing

description: The TRIPI codebase extracts transportation infrastructure from OpenStreetMap and calculates dimensions and embedded material quantities. Leiden University researchers publish Python processing scripts with supporting material-intensity, paving, width and road-quality inputs. The documented workflow uses Geofabrik source files and tools including PyrOSM, osmfilter and osmconvert. It supports roads, railways, parking, bridges and tunnels across many countries, with the associated published dataset based on early-2023 extraction. GitHub provides the repository free under the MIT licence, distinct from the companion dataset’s CC BY 4.0 terms. Local paths and software dependencies need configuration. Differences in map completeness and conflicting 175/176 country descriptions are limitations for comparisons. Modellers could prepare infrastructure stocks for circular-material or replacement-demand simulations. data-openstreetmap provides the source geography and model-odym is a related stock-flow environment. Only repository metadata, the README and file inventory were inspected. No source archive, map file or script was downloaded or executed.
